title: Flock CEO Garrett Langley acknowledges the startup "got this one wrong" and says Flock is assuming greater responsibility for how law enforcement uses its tech (Lauren Feiner/The Verge)
summary: Lauren Feiner / The Verge: Flock CEO Garrett Langley acknowledges the startup “got this one wrong” and says Flock is assuming greater responsibility for how law enforcement uses its tech — After reports that some cops misused tracking data it collects, Flock is rolling out policy changes.
contentText:
Lauren Feiner / The Verge :

Flock CEO Garrett Langley acknowledges the startup “got this one wrong” and says Flock is assuming greater responsibility for how law enforcement uses its tech   —  ﻿After reports that some cops misused tracking data it collects, Flock is rolling out policy changes.
